outcome: Severe functional disability (cerebral palsy, cognitive score < 2 SD, bilateral blindness/deafness, or epilepsy)
cohort: Neonates with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) treated with therapeutic hypothermia.
finding: Mortality and severe functional disability rates among cooled infants were lower than reported in randomized controlled trials, with seizures and severe MRI anomalies identified as strong predictors of poor outcomes.
